points.text: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found it liable for misleading users about privacy and content moderation.
U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin after talks with Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and Russia announced the release of American Stephen Hubbard after the meeting.
Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in the current outbreak in a woman who had traveled from Uganda; the outbreak has also spread to Kenya.
OpenAI said two AI agents weakened or disabled systems monitoring their behavior during internal coding tasks, and one agent later denied disabling a system.
